hypothesis: A new deterministic 10-of-50 FIT-only outcome-stratified selector can retain all four original public (context,action) cells and preserve each FIT full-history Beta(1,1) conditional forecast within absolute 0.10. No claim about held predictive accuracy or native learner.

frozen_design.enumerator: For each observed cell, enumerate every pair of selected positive and selected negative counts within FIT available counts, with at least one selected per cell; retain global allocations summing exactly 10. Choose allocation by lexicographically smallest tuple: max per-cell absolute posterior discrepancy; sum of original cell counts multiplied by squared discrepancy; NEGATIVE total squared native prequential prediction residual of witnesses chosen under the allocation; ordered source witness IDs. Break exact ties by this tuple and no other metric. Fail closed if >10000000 allocations.
frozen_design.witnesses: For each allocated cell/outcome quota, choose individual FIT witnesses in descending squared archived native prequential residual, tie ascending ID. Return original chronological order.
frozen_design.no_held: Neither selection nor engineering FIT evaluation can consume outcomes from indices >=50. Previously consumed 14 VALID and 32 RETURN from PCER-01 must not be re-scored as new science.
controls: exact four-cell sufficient-statistics 8 integer counts reproducing full 50 FIT Beta(1,1); report representation bytes separately and do not equate counts with original native witness history
frozen_design.engineering_gate: 10 unique losslessly referenced FIT witnesses; full original trace bytes remain identical; all 4 cells represented; maximum cell forecast deviation <=0.10; deterministic cold replay, no hidden label access, identity and tamper negatives. ENGINEERING ONLY.
frozen_design.science_gate: NO_RUN pending authenticated original-source owner authorization, fresh independently unfamiliar source families with disjoint TRAIN/VALID/HELD/TRANSFER, untouched native checkpoints, >=3 seeds, matched prior info/actions/compute/actual bytes, fully trained conventional and exact sufficient-statistics controls, independent qualification. Predeclared future native held Brier <= full history +0.02 and at least 0.005 lower than best equal-budget control; cold old-law retention, interference, unfamiliar transfer, intervention utility and cost must be measured. Never claim superiority on existing FIT or consumed PCER-01 held archive.
frozen_design.budgets: No new original/source actions, no model training or native checkpoint writes; pure-Python standard-library deterministic selector with <=10000000 candidate allocations, bounded 50-row FIT input.
frozen_design.seed_identity: Use deterministic witness ID tie-break; uniform control hash sha256('PCER-01|24011|'+witness_id), matching predecessor, to avoid introducing adaptive seed.
frozen_design.decision: FIT failure => engineering NO_GO. FIT PASS => engineering-only readiness, native science still UNVERIFIED, deployment NONE. No retuning after FIT result.

controls_and_stops: invalid phase, prediction or public context
source mutation, index mismatch or output overwrite
inadequate per-cell FIT fidelity, cost or provenance
